I won’t make any changes yet. Please confirm the exact reschedule action before I proceed.

Planned action (what I would do)
- Operation: Reschedule the recurring calendar event.
- Target event: the weekly "Platform Sync" recurring series (the existing series you have on your calendar). — please confirm this is the correct series if you have more than one "Platform Sync".
- Scope: apply the change from the occurrence on Tuesday, 14 October 2026 and move every future occurrence to the new weekly slot (i.e., use "this and following" so past occurrences remain unchanged). Confirm if you instead want "entire series" (including past events) or "single occurrence".
- New time: Tuesdays, 14 Oct 2026 start 09:30, end 10:15, time zone America/New_York (weekly recurrence).
- Attendees: four people — you (calendar owner), Lena Fischer, Marcus Bell, Aditi Shah. Please confirm the exact email address to use for each attendee (or confirm I should use the addresses currently on the event).
- Location/conferencing: keep the existing Zoom conferencing link and remove/leave blank any physical room (no change to conferencing).
- Notifications: this change will send updates to attendees if notifications are enabled. Do you want me to notify attendees? (Yes / No)
- Reversibility: reversible by editing the series again (I can restore the prior schedule if needed), but the calendar update will be visible to attendees if notifications are sent.

Please confirm all of the above (especially: the exact target series if there are multiple, confirm scope = "this and following", confirm attendee emails or that I should use the current addresses, and whether to notify attendees). Once you reply "Confirm — proceed" with those details, I will make the change.
